name: Sign of Discovery
body:
School divination; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You gain a +2 insight bonus to your next Knowledge, Perception, or Sense Motive skill check (if it is made before the end of the next round).
